verdict.rationale: Runpod documents 'Instant Clusters' for fully managed multi-node compute (runpod-docs-4, runpod-docs-17, runpod-docs-37, runpod-docs-54), but this is Runpod's own clustering abstraction — there is no evidence of managed Slurm or Kubernetes scheduling being offered, which is what the story specifically asks for. missing for 10: evidence of managed Slurm scheduler support, evidence of managed Kubernetes support/integration, any job-scheduling semantics tied to Slurm/K8s APIs.
